summary: Add a protected selector-only CI evidence observer

schema.detail: Uses the existing portable v1 evidence format; private observer configuration is not daemon state.

rules.detail: No daemon rule or main landing change.

compatibility.detail: Adds an internal protected observe-ci command. Full trust requires a platform-bound queue/manual source and accepted workflow/recipe pins; PR observations are degraded or test tier. Portable stage enforcement is not activated.

manual.detail: Operators provision and pin the observer with an immutable accepted base, workflow and recipe digests, read-only GitHub access, a private bare repository and signer configuration. No grants or production keys are provisioned here.

recovery.detail: Unavailable signing produces explicit degraded records; a repeated job retains its prior tier. Wrong provenance and malformed artifacts supply no records. CI scheduling, key provisioning and re-attestation integration follow separately.
